_note: Paper-doll layers cut by tools/cut_paperdoll.py, from dev/art/canon-gemini/Gemini_Generated_Image_ktfw47ktfw47ktfw.jpg (the canon sheet) unless a part names one of "sheets" with "sheet": id. crop = WxH+X+Y on the part's sheet. The part's prefix picks its PaperDoll slot and its placement, which is measured: hair face openings fit the body's face and sit on the chin; dresses share the body's baseline; acc_ and hat_ parts use anchor (px from head center-x / head top) and scale; top_, bottom_ and shoes_ parts take the sheet's reference doll's scale and height (on the canon sheet the body is the doll); "offset" [dx, dy] nudges any part. The canon parts set the 721x760 frame; the other sheets' parts are placed on it. Layers keep the sheet's resolution.
_sheets_note: A wardrobe sheet (prompts/image/wardrobe/, staged at its game: path in project/assets/sheets/wardrobe/ and keyed to white as <id>_white.png per .claude/skills/gemini-assets/SKILL.md): "sheets": {"<id>": {"path": "project/assets/sheets/wardrobe/<id>_white.png", "doll": "WxH+X+Y"}}, doll = the crop of the bald reference doll at the sheet's far left; then each part {"sheet": "<id>", "crop": ...}. Cut one sheet with --sheet <id>.
